def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Parse body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
